keyframe_review.note: New keyframe for a state Cliopatria lacks: Cliopatria's kingdom shape 1890-1894 is right in extent but the state changed on 17 January 1893; this dossier takes the shape for 1893 (from January) to July 1894, after which the Republic of Hawaii holds it.

ledger.note: 1893: the Committee of Safety overthrows the monarchy and proclaims a Provisional Government. 'Monarchy overthrown: January 17 1893'; a 13-member Committee of Safety led by Henry E. Cooper proclaimed the government, with Sanford B. Dole as president. Cleveland, after the Blount Report (July 1893), 'called for the reinstatement of Queen Liliʻuokalani'; Dole refused Minister Willis's demand on 23 December 1893.
1894: the Republic of Hawaii replaces the Provisional Government. 'Republic declared: July 4 1894', after the Morgan Report (26 February 1894) and a constitutional convention.

notes: A state Cliopatria lacks: its 'Kingdom of Hawaï'i' row runs to 1894 and its 'Republic of Hawai'i' row begins in 1895, so the eighteen months of the Provisional Government are hidden in the kingdom's last shape. The kingdom dossier adjusts its 1890 shape to 1890-1893; this dossier covers January 1893 - July 1894 with one new keyframe. The Republic of Hawai'i dossier (not in this group's owned list) should start in July 1894. The Hawaiian native name is the usual rendering and is not on the page opened.
